scope: Inventory-only independent review; development data until separately bound to an actual CI artifact.

conservative_classification.interpretation: Rank v_level is additive with touch, not a post-touch scalar. This exclusion does not establish gain-only PCM or absent touch improvement.

historical_audio.scope: Matched local whole-bank PCM; separate from native release qualification and perceptual realism.
historical_audio.source_binding: Historical .5 local capture after 17 integration level corrections but before later long-pad headroom corrections; executable and inventories identified by retained hashes. Not current .5 inventory or .6 committed CI capture.

method.waveform: No time or phase alignment. Each complete stereo clip is divided by its own RMS for equal-RMS residual; delivered audio is never normalized.
method.spectrum: Mean stereo power of 16 equally spaced 4096-frame Hann windows within the held note; DC excluded, interior positive-frequency power doubled, total power normalized. Hellinger distance spans 0–1.
method.time_windows: Early: first 200 ms; late held: final 500 ms before key-up; release tail: last 500 ms after key-up.
method.thresholds: 0.001 equal-RMS residual and 0.01 spectral distance are descriptive counts, not listening or quality acceptance thresholds.
method.limitations: One matched note and velocity gesture per address, plus pressure controls for two intentional silent-at-zero-pressure voices. Phase, articulation, tuning and effects all affect residuals. Differences do not prove realism, preference or exact instrument identity.
